句子: 1. Yesterday I ___(go) to the park.
提示: go 嘅過去式係 went

句子: 2. She ___(eat) an apple this morning.
提示: eat 嘅過去式係 ate

句子: 3. We ___(watch) a funny movie last night.
提示: watch 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 4. My father ___(buy) a new car last Sunday.
提示: buy 嘅過去式係 bought

句子: 5. Tim ___(finish) his homework two hours ago.
提示: finish 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 6. They ___(drink) milk for breakfast today.
提示: drink 嘅過去式係 drank

句子: 7. Mary ___(find) her lost key under the sofa.
提示: find 嘅過去式係 found

句子: 8. I ___(hear) a loud noise last night.
提示: hear 嘅過去式係 heard

句子: 9. The student ___(write) a letter to his teacher yesterday.
提示: write 嘅過去式係 wrote

句子: 10. The baby ___(sleep) for two hours this afternoon.
提示: sleep 嘅過去式係 slept

句子: 11. We ___(play) soccer in the playground yesterday.
提示: play 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 12. Mum ___(make) a big cake for my birthday last week.
提示: make 嘅過去式係 made

句子: 13. The boy ___(trip) over a stone and fell down just now.
提示: trip 字尾係短元音+單輔音，要雙寫 p 再加 ed (tripped)

句子: 14. Uncle Ray ___(give) us a nice present yesterday.
提示: give 嘅過去式係 gave

句子: 15. She ___(brush) her teeth before going to bed last night.
提示: brush 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 16. I ___(see) a pretty bird in the tree ten minutes ago.
提示: see 嘅過去式係 saw

句子: 17. They ___(walk) to school on foot yesterday morning.
提示: walk 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 18. The dog ___(bark) at the stranger just now.
提示: bark 係 Regular verb，字尾加 ed

句子: 19. My teacher ___(tell) us a story this morning.
提示: tell 嘅過去式係 told

句子: 20. Ben ___(draw) a picture of his dog last night.
提示: draw 嘅過去式係 drew

句子: 21. I didn't ___(go) to the library yesterday.
提示: didn't 後面必須用 Verb Root (原形動詞 go)

句子: 22. Did you ___(see) the fireworks last night?
提示: 句首用咗 Did 問，後面動詞要用原形 (see)

句子: 23. My sister and I ___(be) at home yesterday.
提示: 主語係複數 (We)，Be 動詞過去式要用 were

句子: 24. The test ___(be) very easy yesterday.
提示: 主語係單數 (It)，Be 動詞過去式要用 was

句子: 25. Sam didn't ___(clean) his room last weekend.
提示: didn't 後面要用原形動詞 (clean)

句子: 26. ___(Did / Do) you buy any apples at the supermarket yesterday?
提示: 過去式嘅 Yes/No 疑問句要用 Did 開頭

句子: 27. The cat ___(run) up the tree quickly two minutes ago.
提示: run 嘅過去式係 ran

句子: 28. We ___(have) a great time at the party last night.
提示: have 嘅過去式係 had

句子: 29. Jenny ___(spend) $20 to buy a notebook yesterday.
提示: spend 嘅過去式係 spent

句子: 30. The bus ___(stop) at the bus stop five minutes ago.
提示: stop 係短元音+單輔音，要雙寫 p 再加 ed (stopped)

句子: 31. They ___(not be) hungry after lunch yesterday.
提示: 主語係 They，Be 動詞否定過去式係 were not / weren't

句子: 32. It ___(not be) rainy last Sunday.
提示: 主語係 It，Be 動詞否定過去式係 was not / wasn't

句子: 33. What time did you ___(wake) up this morning?
提示: 問句中有 did，動詞要回復原形 (wake)

句子: 34. Harry ___(find) his lost keys under the table just now.
提示: find 嘅過去式係 found

句子: 35. The teacher ___(give) us a quiz two days ago.
提示: give 嘅過去式係 gave

句子: 36. We didn't ___(have) music class last Tuesday.
提示: didn't 後面接原形動詞 (have)

句子: 37. The little girl ___(cry) loudly because she lost her toy.
提示: cry 字尾係輔音+y，要去 y 加 ied (cried)

句子: 38. Mr. Chan ___(teach) English to us last year.
提示: teach 嘅過去式係 taught

句子: 39. She ___(sing) a sweet song in the school concert yesterday.
提示: sing 嘅過去式係 sang

句子: 40. They ___(drink) all the juice at the picnic yesterday.
提示: drink 嘅過去式係 drank

句子: 41. Tom usually walks to school, but he ___(take) a bus yesterday.
提示: usually 用 Simple Present，但後半句有 yesterday 必須改用過去式 (took)

句子: 42. Mum helped me ___(do) my homework last night.
提示: 雖然係 last night，但 help 屬特殊動詞，後面接原形動詞 (do)

題型: 常態 vs 過去事件
句子: 43. I ___(be) late for school this morning, so teacher scolded me.
提示: 今朝早遲到係已發生的事，I 配合 was

句子: 44. My father ___(cut) the birthday cake five minutes ago.
提示: cut 嘅過去式依然係 cut（不變形）

句子: 45. He ___(put) his books into the bag just now.
提示: put 嘅過去式依然係 put（不變形）

句子: 46. Although it was cold, they still ___(go) swimming yesterday.
提示: 前半句 was 顯示全句為過去時態，go 要變 went

句子: 47. Where did your family ___(go) for vacation last summer?
提示: 句中有助動詞 did，後面動詞必須用原形 (go)

句子: 48. The chef ___(fry) some chicken wings for us last night.
提示: fry 字尾係輔音+y，要去 y 加 ied (fried)

句子: 49. Yesterday, Alex came home, ___(wash) his hands and ate dinner.
提示: 連續動作，came 同 ate 均為過去式，同鏈動詞 wash 亦須改為 washed

句子: 50. There ___(be) many people in the park last Sunday.
提示: past tense 加名詞複數 (many people)，Be 動詞要用 were
